text.tspan: Prefix caching: reuse the KV cache when prompts start the same way
'You are a support bot for ShopCo…'
kept in GPU memory after request 1
found in the cache: skip the work
Only an exact match from the very first token counts, so put the fixed part first and the changing part last.
Common shared prefixes: system prompts, chat history, few-shot examples, one long document asked many questions.
